title: PromptGuard at BLP-2025 Task 1: A Few-Shot Classification Framework Using Majority Voting and Keyword Similarity for Bengali Hate Speech Detection
reasoning: The paper evaluates and benchmarks performance on 'Religious Hate' and 'Sexism' as core classification categories. It includes specific keyword sets and analysis for religious groups (e.g., Muslim, Hindu, Jew) and moral categories, making religion and ethics central to the evaluation framework.
